name: Essential Elements
description: v1's quark-model mix of life's elements scattered at random (192 H, 47 N, 55 C, 20 O, 2 Mg, 1 Fe, 4 Zn, 3 Cu); 26 of them are antimatter (charges and nuclear charge flipped). Each atom is 3Z up + 3Z down quarks and Z electrons under v1's powAXv2 nuclear force and Coulomb. Gravity (G ≈ 7e-39) is negligible and omitted.
